title: Nine Lives Academy
subtitle: Magic Academy · A Cat Life Simulator
description: A moonmoth carries an ordinary house cat into the Nine Lives Academy. All 33 events are life-path choices: what kind of magical cat will you become?

catalog.headline: A cat's nine lives become one magical path.
catalog.description: Draw talents and face 33 magical decisions. Every event is a life-path choice, not a temporary small action.
catalog.cardDescription: Fire, water, lightning, dungeons, dragons, coins, slimes, skeletons, unicorns, griffins, double-headed eagles, chimeras, warriors, priests, elves, dwarves, merchants, demon kings, and witches are all organized into clear life paths.
catalog.actionSummary: Draw talents · Learn magic · Meet monsters

states.label: Magic
states.description: 0 Apprentice, 15 Formal Mage, 30 Archmage, 45 Magus, 60 Grand Magus, 75 Cat God

states.label: Courage
states.description: Bravery before dragons, demon kings, and lightning

states.label: Curiosity
states.description: The urge to open books, enter mazes, and question spells

milestones.title: Formal Mage
milestones.text: Your first spell no longer needs a yawn as a wind-up.

milestones.title: Archmage
milestones.text: The tower window now leaves a lamp lit for you.

milestones.title: Magus
milestones.text: You can hold three spells at once; one is only for roasting fish.

milestones.title: Grand Magus
milestones.text: The stars begin consulting your class schedule.

milestones.title: Cat God
milestones.text: Every dried fish in the world blinks at you at once.

events.title: The Admission Moth
events.event: A moonmoth brings an admission letter to the Nine Lives Academy. How will you answer it?

choices.result: You follow the moth through the dark, and the door at the end of the corridor opens by itself.

choices.text: Verify whether the letter is real
choices.result: The letter smells like dried fish and stardust. You memorize the scent.
The paper plane flies out, the moth chases it, and you chase the moth.

events.title: The Wand Shop
events.event: The three wands in the shop represent three different magical paths. Which one will you choose?

choices.result: A fire-salamander whisker runs through the core, and warm light immediately rises from your fingertip.
The shaft looks like driftwood after low tide, and each swing leaves a ring of water.
Both wands glow at once, and the shopkeeper cat records the anomaly in the ledger.

events.title: The Crystal Ball
events.event: The divination crystal asks what future you want to see. What do you choose?

choices.result: A fish appears first, then your nine tails.
You press your paw against it, and a tiny rain falls inside the sphere.
The sphere is lighter than expected, and your nine tails appear inside it.

events.title: Fire Magic
events.event: Fire class asks you to choose your fire path. What kind of fire cat will you become?

choices.result: The flame curls into a ring and slightly crisps your whiskers.
You press the flame into a warm cushion and roast a dried fish beside it.
The flame goes out, and the classroom is quiet for a second.

events.title: Water Magic
events.event: Water class offers three directions. Which path will you take?

choices.result: A bubble holds the whole academy's reflection, and you nudge it into a pearl.
The stream curves around the desk and pours exactly into the flowerpot; the professor nods.
The mist spreads like a very small morning.

events.title: Lightning Magic
events.event: The lightning tower asks how you will live with lightning. What will you become?

choices.result: The bolt lands on your tail like someone gently plucking a string.
You hold the lightning in your throat and breathe out a tiny star.
The lightning runs down your tail into the ground, and you feel like a very competent lightning rod.

events.title: Dungeon Training
events.event: Dungeon training is not just escape; it is a choice among three adventurer paths. Which one are you?

choices.result: You finish the corridor beside the wall shadows; the skeleton soldiers never look up.
You charge through the door and knock a row of barrels into glowing shards.
The seventh torch is dozing. You gently straighten it.

events.title: The Dragon Lair
events.event: The dragon lair is not only treasure; it is also three ways to relate to a stronger being. Which relationship do you choose?

choices.result: The dragon pushes three coins toward you with its tail and leaves behind a warm scale.
You understand the dragon's breathing rhythm, like a pot slowly coming to a boil.
The dragon does not look up. You take the smallest coin.

events.title: The Coin Vault
events.event: The coin vault offers three paths: wealth, structure, and magic. How will you handle it?

choices.result: The coins' echoes tell you which one is fake.
You stack the coins into a tower, and its tip points to the exit.
The coins line themselves up, and the accountant cat nods.

events.title: Slime Battle
events.event: The slime battle asks whether you are a fighter, an athlete, or a diplomat. Which cat are you?

choices.result: The slimes freeze into jelly, and your paw leaves three prints on the surface.
You bounce one to the ceiling, and it becomes a very sticky lamp.
The slime is sticky but very polite.

events.title: Skeleton Soldiers
events.event: Before the skeleton soldiers are three paths: faith, puzzle, and art. Which one do you choose?

choices.result: Holy light arranges the bones into a quiet honor guard.
You swap two bones, and the skeleton starts solving itself like a puzzle.
The bones rattle lightly with the rhythm, like a xylophone.

events.title: The Unicorn Grove
events.event: The unicorn's stardust represents three values: closeness, meditation, and collection. Which do you choose?

choices.result: The unicorn lowers its head and lets you sniff the light on its forehead.
You count the light three times, and stardust from the horn falls into your fur.
The stardust glows in your pocket, and today feels a little longer.

events.title: The Griffin Tower
events.event: The griffin tower asks you to choose your relationship with the sky: training, companionship, or exchange.

choices.result: You grab the griffin's feathers, and the wind turns your ears into two small flags.
You share a dried fish, and it leaves you its brightest feather.
The griffin takes the feather and returns a brighter one.

events.title: The Double-Headed Eagle
events.event: The double-headed eagle brings a message that needs interpretation. What kind of communicator will you be?

choices.result: Each head says half a sentence, and you join them in your mind.
You reply with paw prints, and the eagle rolls the letter into a very official scroll.
Both heads are satisfied.

events.title: The Chimera Maze
events.event: The chimera maze offers three responses: divide, disguise, or remain still. Which do you choose?

choices.result: You lure the three heads in three directions and take the fourth path.

choices.hint: Pretend to be the fifth head
choices.result: You lower your tail, and the chimera thinks you are its fifth head.
The chimera walks around you once without waking you.

events.title: The Warrior Companion
events.event: The warrior companion asks you to define the relationship: sparring, sharing, or observing.

choices.result: The wooden sword and your paw stop midair; you recognize each other.
The warrior bites the dried fish and writes you into the adventure contract.
The wooden sword stops an inch away from you, and he smiles.

events.title: The Priest's Healing
events.event: The priest's healing asks you to choose recovery: faith, rest, or self-healing.

choices.result: Light flows over your wound like a very warm little river.
You sleep beside the altar for ten minutes and wake up healed.
It tastes a little like mineral water, only warmer.

events.title: The Elf Library
events.event: The elf library gives you three knowledge paths: deep study, borrowing, or returning.

choices.result: The pages turn themselves to the line you need most.
The elf hands you a slim book and says, 'Do not fold the corner.' You fold a very small one.
The elf librarian nods at you for the first time.

events.title: The Dwarf Forge
events.event: The dwarf forge represents three paths: craft, research, and courage. Which do you choose?

choices.result: Hammer and sparks land together; your paw pads learn not to fear heat.
You notice the third rune stroke is crooked, and the dwarf freezes.
The sparks burst into a tiny flower on your paw pad.

events.title: The Scroll Riddle
events.event: The scroll riddle asks you to choose a solving style: direct, record, or ask for help.

choices.result: The final word lights up, and the scroll rolls itself into a small staff.
You copy the whole incantation, and your handwriting looks more like paw prints than the original.
The cat does not understand, but the scroll does.

events.title: The Incantation
events.event: The incantation asks you to choose expression: tradition, creation, or inner cultivation.

choices.result: A low purr rolls from your throat, and the spell takes shape.
You turn the spell into a lullaby, and every chair in the classroom falls asleep.
The classroom stays quiet, and the spell forms inside your throat on its own.

events.title: The Magic Circle
events.event: The magic circle asks how you will relate to it: repair, risk, or offering.

choices.result: The chalk line becomes a breathing river under your paw.
The ring lights up while you stand exactly at its center.
When the ring lights up, the dried fish turns into light.

events.title: The Cat Church
events.event: The cat church asks you to choose a way of faith: prayer, rest, or service.

choices.result: The candles bend toward you as if nodding.
You fall asleep beneath the pew and dream of nine fish in a ring.
The candle flames become a little tidier.

events.title: The Cat Adventurers' Guild
events.event: The adventurers' guild is not just a job board; it is a choice of adventure style. Which adventurer are you?

choices.result: You accept a quest, and the board replaces the name with your paw print.
You set a coin on the table corner, and a warrior who listens to you joins the party.
You wipe the name off the wooden board and write your own.

events.title: The Academy Festival
events.event: The academy festival asks whether you belong on stage, in the judge's seat, or backstage.

choices.result: You turn lightning into fireworks, and the audience bursts into catcalls.
You give every stall full marks except the one that turned dried fish into perfume.
Thirty wishes light up at the same time.

events.title: The Thieves' Guild Invitation
events.event: The thieves' guild invites you to join. What kind of underworld cat will you become?

choices.result: You move from shadow to shadow like thread through a needle.
The lock clicks open as softly as a blink.
The lock is simple; the hard part is not making a sound.

events.title: Archer Training
events.event: Archer training asks you to choose your combat distance: ranged, scouting, or melee.

choices.result: When the arrow flies, you are already waiting at the landing point.
The grass tells you which way the target will sway.
Three tidy claw marks appear on the wooden post.

events.title: The Night Walker's Choice
events.event: The night guard asks whether you will become a night walker. What do you choose?

choices.result: You hide inside your own shadow; it is a little crowded.
You toss a coin, and every gaze follows it around once.
Only your own shadow remains in the dark.

events.title: The Demon King
events.event: The demon king is not only an enemy but also a choice: confrontation, diplomacy, or trade.

choices.result: The demon king leans down and offers you a small corner of the throne.
The demon king sniffs your dried fish and says, 'So this is a cat's scepter.'
The demon king places the dried fish on the armrest like a medal.

events.title: The Witch's Bargain
events.event: The witch's contract asks how you will bargain with magic: negotiate, refuse, or be cautious.

choices.result: The witch rewrites the contract as three dried fish and one whisker.
You pull your paw back, and the witch smiles for the first time.
The contract is small enough for only one paw print. The witch smiles, and your days feel a little longer.

events.title: The Merchant Cat's Stardust Stall
events.event: The merchant cat asks you to choose your spending style: magic, protection, or saving.

choices.result: The vial holds a short piece of the night sky, and when you open it every shadow in the classroom turns blue.
The charm warms under your paw like a stone that has just been in the sun.
You sniff every item on the stall, then walk away satisfied.

events.title: The Dragon's Hoard
events.event: The dragon's hoard asks you to choose your relationship with wealth and risk: steal, request, or restrain.

choices.result: The scale is hot, and you hold it in your mouth until your eyes shine from the pain.
The dragon lowers its head and pushes a fallen scale toward you.
The dragon sweeps one coin to you with the tip of its tail.

events.title: The Underground Maze
events.event: The underground maze asks you to choose an exploration style: risk, depth, or caution.

choices.result: The floor collapses half a step, and your fish pouch falls into the pit.
At the bottom of the stairs is a very old door.
You squeeze through the crack with almost no sound.

endings.title: Cat God · All the Dried Fish in the World
endings.description: You become the Cat God who keeps every dried fish in the world. First decree: every cat deserves one warm fish before sleep.

endings.title: Grand Magus · Star Dome Lecturer
endings.description: You lecture beneath the star dome, your syllabus a single glowing whisker.

endings.title: Archmage · Light of the Tower
endings.description: You turn the tower lamp into a small sun dedicated to warming cats.

endings.title: Wandering Magus · Nine-Lives Traveler
endings.description: You leave with a wand and dried fish; every paw print on the map becomes your waypoint.

endings.title: Academy Librarian Cat
endings.description: You take over the elf library, where every book learns to shelve itself while you sleep.

endings.title: Sleepy Cat
endings.description: You did not become a Grand Magus, but you sleep extremely successfully beside the festival stove.
